title: Usagi Shima: Bunny Island
description:
Want to build a bunny paradise? Embark on a bunny-filled journey in Usagi Shima, where you transform an abandoned island into a cozy haven for adorable bunnies! Usagi Shima is a relaxing, bunny-collecting idle game. 

 

Embark on a bunny-filled journey in Usagi Shima, where you transform an abandoned island into a cozy haven for adorable bunnies!

Decorate your island with toys, plants, and charming buildings to entice curious bunnies to pay your island a visit!

Collect items and watch your bunnies interact with them. Relax and enjoy the calm and cozy island atmosphere! 🏝️

Discover 35+ unique bunnies, each with their own favorite toys, decorations, and idea of a perfect day.
Learn what makes them happy and watch your island fill up with new friends! See if you can meet and collect them all! 

Show some love to your bunnies! Pet them, feed them, play with them, and brush their fluffy fur. Watch your bunny friends thrive as you shower them with care.

Capture adorable memories with your bunny buddies using the photo feature, and create a scrapbook filled with heartwarming moments. Dress them in delightful hats and earn a special gift as you become the best of bunny buddies! 

Already an editor's choice with millions of downloads on the App Store and Google Play, the PC version of Usagi Shima has been rebuilt from the ground up with new and exclusive features, quality-of-life improvements, and no microtransactions, so decorating your island and spending time with your buns is easier than ever!

 

Hi, I’m Jess! I absolutely love rabbits and have grown up with these cute and charming animals my whole life 🐰 I quit my tech job to pursue my creative passions and bring these adorable virtual bunnies to life 🐇🐇 

I started out solo for several years, but have since created a tiny game studio with my husband, where we hope to continue bringing you cute and relaxing games!

From our tiny team at studio rabbiko, we really hope you'll enjoy our little bunny game, Usagi Shima 🐇💖

• Discover and collect 35+ rabbits with unique looks and features! 

• Collect 100+ items to decorate with, some even interactive! 

• Pet, feed, brush, and play hide and seek with the bunnies to build friendship 

• Dress up your bunnies with adorable hats! 

• Receive keepsakes from bunnies you’ve become best friends with, and even invite them to stay on your island   

• Take snapshots to build an adorable photo album and even make the captured photos into device wallpapers 

• Turn Usagi Shima into a cozy screensaver - Let the bunnies keep you company while you study or work!

• Hand-drawn and traditionally animated art style 

• Customize your day/night cycle or sync with real-time, experience the island ambience that matches your mood

• Cozy idle gameplay with no time limits, no stress, peaceful and soothing to play at your own pace!
description_short: Welcome to Usagi Shima! Build your own bunny paradise, attract fluffy tourists with toys and decorations, and befriend lovable bunnies by feeding, petting, and playing with them. Relax with rabbits in a beautiful sandbox of your own design.
